description: Weekly, grouped dependency updates for the npm launcher (typescript/). The Python launcher's ranges, GitHub Actions pins and the Chromium pin in browser/upstream.sh are changed by hand: each of them moves what the test pipeline runs against.

packageRules.description: Non-major npm updates: one pull request a week.
Playwright decides which upstream suite the pipeline runs; it is bumped by hand, with ci/versions.py and python/pyproject.toml.
